title: Kustomize ValueAddTransformer
description: Configuration file for the Kustomize value add transformer. Referenced from the `transformers` field of a kustomization.yaml file.

apiVersion.description: The API version of the transformer. Always `builtin` for built-in transformers

targetFilePath.description: A file path to a file containing a slice of Target which will be appended to anything specified in the targets field

targets.description: The targets that should have the value added

value.description: The value to add. Defaults to the base name of the encompassing kustomization root

Selector.description:
Selector specifies a set of resources.
Any resource that matches intersection of all conditions is included in this set.

annotationSelector.description:
AnnotationSelector is a string that follows the label selection expression
https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/#api

labelSelector.description:
LabelSelector is a string that follows the label selection expression
https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/#api

Target.description: Target describes where to put the value

fieldPath.description: A JSON-style path to the field intended to hold the value

filePathPosition.description: Position of the field path in the file path

selector.description: Selector selects the resources to modify. If omitted, all resources are modified
